See it in action Speak with an expert
Interactive demo of the MiVIP dashboard, case management, and settings
Your screen appears too small for the best demo experience. Feel free to watch the demo video above, and please revisit the below interactive demo when you’re in front of a larger monitor.

Easily build KYC journeys that specifically meet your requirements and risk appetite. With the ability to layer a range of identity services according to the level of assurance required, you can onboard new customers more confidently.

To fight AI-driven fraud, you need AI-powered tools. Mitek's Digital Fraud Defender helps protect against deepfakes, AI-altered documents, template attacks, presentation attacks, injection attacks, and digital spoofs that even the human eye would struggle to pick up.

Create a login process as secure and trusted as the onboarding journey. MiPass enables passwordless authentication with biometrics. The selfie captured during identity verification can be used for seamless authentication throughout the customer lifecycle, and users can enroll with one click.

Your customers are demanding. They expect simplicity and robust security. Getting the right balance between user experience and the friction necessary for strong fraud controls is a challenge. With the MiVIP platform, you can optimize your identity services to get the best of both.
Get the in-depth buyer’s guide

The MiVIP platform provides access to a range of IDV tools and empowers clients to design custom journeys through an easy-to- use administrative UI. We combine a wide range of identity verification techniques and deploy them through a single API, allowing our clients to control and configure the right verification types for their exact needs.

MiVIP brings together the identity services businesses need to build secure, flexible, and compliant digital journeys. Rather than sourcing and integrating separate tools for verification, fraud detection, compliance screening, and authentication, organizations can access these capabilities through a single configurable platform.
Authenticates government-issued IDs, extracts data, and detects tampered or synthetic documents.
Matches a live selfie to the identity document to confirm the person is present and genuine.
Screens individuals against sanctions lists, politically exposed persons (PEP) databases, and adverse media sources to support anti-money laundering compliance.
Surfaces fraud signals and risk scores to inform verification decisions and support customer due diligence.
Lets teams build, manage, and adjust identity workflows through an administrative interface, without rebuilding integrations each time requirements change.
Enables returning customers to authenticate using the biometric captured at onboarding, removing the need for passwords or one-time passcodes.
Detects deepfakes, injection attacks, template fraud, and other AI-generated attack types through Mitek's Digital Fraud Defender.

Deepfake attacks are accelerating. In 2025, 77% of anti-fraud professionals reported an increase in deepfake-related social engineering attacks, and 83% expected further increases. Having document verification, biometrics, and fraud detection connected within the same platform means those defenses work together rather than in separate silos.

With the ability to layer data, documents, biometrics, risk insights, and AML screening, Mitek’s identity verification and authentication solutions help businesses of all sizes build risk-appropriate identity services that can adapt to peaks in demand or scale with your business as it grows.

Teams can use hosted no-code experiences to launch quickly, low-code options to configure pre-built components and workflows, or API and SDK integrations to build custom identity journeys directly into existing digital experiences.
Everything set up for you
Quick integration through our hosted web interface with minimal technical requirements.
More control, support when needed
Simplified integration using our SDKs with pre-built components and workflows.
Direct API integration for custom implementation
For organizations with complex requirements, Mitek’s professional services team can help design, test, and optimize identity journeys for security, compliance, conversion, and operational efficiency.
This flexibility helps businesses move faster while still maintaining control over verification logic, user experience, branding, and fraud controls.
Experience the end user journey

The initial introduction page provides an opportunity to explain the verification process and set expectations for the user; ensuring the journey runs smoothly and they have a great customer experience. At any time throughout the process, they can save, exit, and return later to complete the verification if they are interrupted.

Once the user is shown the steps they will need to complete, the system guides them to provide the specific document (or documents) required for the verification. Mitek accepts hundreds of documents globally and tailoring both the journey and acceptable documents can be easily done through the MiVIP console.

After selecting the document they wish to submit (multiple document types can be defined by the business), the user’s camera is activated and they are guided to take a photo (or photos) of their document. The images are instantly checked for authenticity and verification of the extracted data.

To ensure the user is genuine and present, the system checks for liveness by prompting them to take a selfie. After providing some quick tips to ensure a successful capture, the system activates the device’s camera and guides them to position their face in the frame. The user is given real-time feedback to ensure proper positioning and then the picture is taken automatically.

If enabled, Digital Fraud Defender can protect against sophisticated AI-driven fraud like deepfakes, injection attacks, and re-usable template IDs. These checks are both near-instantaneous and imperceptible to the end user. However, flags for any detected fraud will show up in the MiVIP console to give a complete picture of the individual alongside a detailed explanation of the verification outcome.

Once the end user’s verification journey is complete, they are shown a checklist which confirms each step in the process has been successfully fulfilled. Once processed, all information is securely stored, and the final verification result can be accessed via the MiVIP console for further review and a fully compliant audit trail.
Trusted by over 7,000 organizations worldwide

MiVIP — which allows customers to combine many forms of identity verification technology — has not only made customer onboarding simpler and quicker for end users, but also helped achieve a significant drop in fraudulent applications.

Fraudsters don’t rest. They’re constantly evolving, which means we need to stay agile and adaptable. This isn’t a future threat, it’s happening right now. We’ve adopted Mitek’s fraud detection solution because of the clear benefits it brings in tackling these types of emerging fraud.

Each channel has a bespoke method of authentication. Enabling the customer to have a seamless and consistent experience no matter how they interact with our organization is really important. Biometrics is the center of that strategy.
We chose to work with a partner like Mitek because their platform enables us to easily build a range of digital onboarding journeys that are simple for our new customers to complete.
IT’S NOT JUST OUR CUSTOMERS WHO BELIEVE IN MIVIP.
A strong fit with flexiblity
MiVIP is a strong fit for organizations that need to build flexible identity journeys while balancing security, compliance, fraud prevention, and customer experience.
Use MiVIP when you need to:
Build configurable KYC and identity verification journeys
Layer document verification, biometrics, AML screening, fraud detection, and risk insights
Detect deepfakes, injection attacks, manipulated documents, and other AI-generated fraud threats
Support both customer onboarding and returning-user authentication
Give internal teams more control over verification workflows
Scale identity services across products, regions, and risk levels
Reduce reliance on disconnected point solutions
MiVIP helps teams apply the right identity services at the right moment, so they can protect the business while keeping legitimate customers moving.
See how MiVIP fits your specific requirements.
Who is MiVIP built for?
MiVIP is built for organizations that need to verify identities, reduce fraud, meet compliance requirements, and deliver secure digital experiences at scale.
Banks, fintechs, lenders, marketplaces, and regulated enterprises can use MiVIP to create identity journeys that match their risk policies, customer expectations, and compliance obligations.

Whether teams need to onboard new customers, authenticate returning users, screen for financial crime, or protect high-risk transactions, MiVIP gives them the flexibility to apply the right identity services at the right moment.
Why do teams choose MiVIP over point solutions?

Most organizations running identity verification today rely on a combination of separate tools: one for document checks, another for biometrics, a third for AML screening, and something else for authentication. Each tool works in isolation. The gaps between them are where problems develop.
MiVIP helps businesses move beyond fragmented identity tools and manage the identity lifecycle through a more connected platform.
What do disconnected solutions cost you?
When identity tools do not share data or logic, several problems follow:
Slower fraud response. A fraud signal detected in one system does not automatically inform decisions in another. By the time the information is acted on, the attack may have succeeded.
Inconsistent customer experiences. Separate tools mean separate user interfaces, separate friction points, and separate failure modes. Customers notice.
Higher operational overhead. Managing vendor relationships, contracts, and integrations for each tool takes time and resource that could go toward building better products.
Compliance gaps. When verification, screening, and authentication are not connected, audit trails become fragmented and compliance reporting becomes harder to defend.
What does a connected platform change?

MiVIP connects verification, fraud defense, compliance screening, and authentication so that each layer informs the others. A document check feeds into a biometric match. A risk score influences whether AML screening is triggered. An onboarding biometric becomes the credential for future authentication. The result is a more consistent, defensible identity process, managed through a single platform rather than across multiple vendor relationships.

For regulated organizations, that consistency matters. Fraudsters increasingly use AI to create synthetic identities and convincing fake documents. A 456% increase in GenAI-enabled scams was recorded in 2025. Responding to that threat requires defenses that are coordinated, not siloed.
Ready to see how MiVIP compares to your current setup? Download the IDV buyer's guide to evaluate your options with a structured framework.

Identity verification is the process of ensuring a person is who they are claiming to be. It’s a crucial part of doing business, and is essential for preventing fraud, financial crime, and complying with legal and regulatory requirements. At a time when so many transactions take place online, identity verification plays a crucial role in building digital trust, and can be accomplished using a variety of methods, from checking authoritative data sources, to using biometrics and document verification.
How do identity verification services work?

Identity verification services typically work by capturing personal information from an individual (sometimes extracted from a government-issued ID) and comparing it to trusted and authoritative data sources to ensure that a) the person exists and is a real person, b) there is a record of them that has existed over time, and c) the person claiming the identity is the actual owner of it. In addition, most identity verification services will provide other means of risk assessment in order to meet financial crime compliance guidelines (where required).
What is considered banking-grade identity verification?

The banking sector is heavily regulated, with extensive KYC, AML and good practice guidelines (e.g. GPG45 in the UK) in place to protect consumers and businesses against fraud, financial crime and terrorist financing. ‘Banking-grade’ identity verification refers to solutions that meet the rigorous regulatory standards imposed upon the sector. These systems typically involve multi-layered checks that can include document authentication, biometrics, risk assessments and more. The term has come to represent the highest benchmark for identity verification with regards to security, accuracy and compliance. The Mitek MiVIP platform is considered ‘banking-grade’, and the number of banks and financial institutions that can be counted as customers is a testament to that.
Why do banks/financial institutions/etc. choose MiVIP for an identity verification service?

Banks and financial institutions choose MiVIP because it helps them meet the rigorous standards expected of them by regulators and consumers alike. It gives them complete flexibility and control of their identity verification solutions. Whether that’s to manage, configure and control a specialist identity solution (like document verification) that’s been integrated via an API into an existing customer journey(s), or to orchestrate layers of digital trust and fraud tools to find that optimal balance between strong fraud protections and simple customer experiences. Mitek’s ability to protect against even the most sophisticated AI fraud, like deepfakes and other manipulated content, plays an important role in meeting the highest regulatory standards.
What makes MiVIP the best digital identity verification solution?
MiVIP stands out as the best digital identity verification solution for:

Its ability to connect identity verification and authentication. MiVIP can make it easier for businesses to use and manage biometrics beyond onboarding. With the selfie from the verification process (alongside additional voice recognition), they can create more secure, trusted processes for existing customers, like secure password-less login, or transaction authorization.

It’s proficiency in detecting even the most complex and convincing AI-driven fraud with Digital Fraud Defender. The layered solution uses biometrics and sophisticated AI to protect against deepfakes and other AI-generated fraud, as well as the common attack types that go hand-in-hand with AI fraud, like injection attacks.

It’s core flexibility. Allowing the platform to cater to the requirements of a variety of customers with different needs. It can be used to manage, configure and control specialist identity solutions (like document verification), as well as to orchestrate full identity journeys with layers of services.
Its ability to scale in-line with customer demand (volume of verifications) and across geographies to support expansion plans and compliance in new jurisdictions.
Is MiVIP an online identity verification solution?

Yes, MiVIP is an online identity verification solution. It enables businesses to verify the identity of customers remotely. With a variety of options available to them, businesses can build an identity verification process that entirely suits their needs, giving their customers the freedom to complete the process from anywhere, through a mobile phone, laptop or other device. It makes it ideal for companies looking to provide seamless online customer experiences while maintaining high security and compliance standards.
Yes, MiVIP is incredibly flexible and can be customized in a variety of ways.

As an orchestration platform customers can build identity journeys that are specific to their requirements, flexible to the risk of each consumer, and using a variety of tools, like data, documents, biometrics, fraud risk assessments or AML screening. Moreover, customers can build and host more than one journey on the MiVIP platform, to accommodate different requirements (perhaps different risk profiles, products or regions).

The platform (the administrative user interface) and customer facing elements of the customer journey can also be fully branded. For example, the document verification and biometric user interface can be aligned to an individual business’s corporate branding, so that they seamlessly integrate as part of a wider onboarding journey. This branding can be controlled via the MiVIP platform, so customers have full control of this process.

Mitek’s ability to protect against even the most sophisticated AI fraud, like deepfakes and other manipulated content, plays an important role in meeting the highest regulatory standards.

raw_blocks: Mitek: The global leader in digital identity for fraud prevention
Mitek is dedicated to redefining digital identity and fraud prevention, providing businesses with innovative solutions to protect what’s real in an increasingly digital world.
Protecting what’s real across every digital interaction

Specializing in identity verification, authentication, biometrics, image capture, and fraud detection, our products ensure swift onboarding, instant identity verification, and robust defense against rising threats, such as check fraud, deepfakes, and AI-powered fraud. Trusted by millions globally, our enterprise-grade solutions are relied on by some of the world’s leading enterprises, offering peace of mind for both the company and their customers. Our mission is simple but essential: To protect what’s real.
A global team committed to digital trust and innovation

We are a global team of builders, thinkers, and operators driven by purpose and ambition. United as one team, we earn trust through our actions and strive for excellence in everything we do. With courage and clarity, we embrace change and lead through innovation developing the proof layer in a world of digital deception. By combining AI, capture, and biometrics, we help verify identities and stop fraud across billions of transactions. Our culture is one of learning, caring, and making a difference, not just in technology, but in people’s lives.
Leadership driving Mitek’s mission to stop fraud at scale
Meet the team guiding Mitek’s mission to build lasting value for our customers delivering secure, scalable technology that protects what’s real and powers trusted interactions around the world.

Our team brings vision, clarity, and momentum to our mission of protecting what’s real. Together, we’re building a culture where innovation thrives, trust is earned, and people are empowered to do their best work.
40 years of firsts: Mitek’s history of identity innovation
1990s Establishes early leadership in check imaging, laying the groundwork for mobile innovation.
1989 Goes public on NASDAQ (MITK), raising capital to expand in financial document software.
1986 Mitek is founded with a focus on image analytics and OCR for financial institutions.
2011 Begins applying mobile imaging to insurance, healthcare, and account onboarding.
2010 Introduces Mobile Photo Bill Pay™, expanding “point, shoot, transact” innovation.
2008 Launches Mobile Deposit®, the first app to let users deposit checks via smartphone.
2018 Surpasses 2 billion checks processed via Mobile Deposit, $1.5T in value.
2018 Enhances OCR, AI and handwriting recognition for checks and IDs, through A2iA acquisition.
2017 Gains machine learning-based ID authentication and LATAM coverage, through ICAR acquisition.
2015 Enters identity verification with document + selfie matching, throughAcquires IDchecker acquisition.
2013 Announces IPO on NASDAQ under its MITK ticker.
Expand reach in digital identity
2022 Launches Mitek’s Verified Identity Platform (MiVIP), a unified identity platform.
2022 Adds end-to-end identity orchestration for KYC, through HooYu acquisition.
2021 Adds proprietary passive liveness detection and face/voice biometrics through acquisition of ID R&D (USA).
2021 Launches Check Fraud Defender™, using AI and consortium data to stop altered checks across channels.
Today Introduces a new purpose: To protect what’s real across digital interactions.
2025 Announces industry expert Garrett Gafke as COO.
2024 IDLive® Face earns top marks in U.S. DHS testing solidifying biometric leadership.
2024 Check Fraud Defender receives Datos Insights award for industry-leading fraud.
2024 Edward H. West appointed as CEO.
Industry recognition for biometric and fraud prevention leadership
